name: Product Designer App
author: Product Designer App

sections.description:
Product Designer App is a professional WooCommerce product designer and online product customizer plugin for print shops, print-on-demand stores, gift personalization businesses, apparel brands, sign makers, stationery shops, and any WordPress store that sells customizable products.

With Product Designer App, customers can personalize products directly on your website. They can add text, upload photos, choose artwork, apply templates, customize colors, generate QR codes or barcodes, preview designs, and add customized products to the WooCommerce cart. Store owners can manage product bases, design areas, templates, artwork libraries, printing methods, pricing rules, orders, and production-ready design files from a dedicated admin panel.

The plugin helps you turn a standard WooCommerce store into a complete online design studio for products such as t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, business cards, flyers, posters, banners, stickers, phone cases, labels, packaging, uniforms, teamwear, and other personalized products.

Live Demo and Tutorials

Explore Product Designer App before installing:

  • Live shop demo: https://demo.productdesignerapp.com/wordpress/shop
  • Design template demo: https://demo.productdesignerapp.com/wordpress/design-template
  • Free design resources: https://productdesignerapp.com/resource
  • Documentation: https://docs.productdesignerapp.com
  • Installation guide: https://docs.productdesignerapp.com/docs/installation
  • Product setup examples: https://docs.productdesignerapp.com/docs/product-setup-examples
  • Product Designer App Pro: https://productdesignerapp.com/shop/woocommerce
  • Help center: https://help.productdesignerapp.com
  • Product overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gFbe-sjMju4
  • Installation video tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hb3zdTbaT94
  • YouTube tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/@productdesignerapp

Why Choose Product Designer App?

Product Designer App is built for real production workflows, not only simple product previews. It combines customer-facing design tools with admin controls for managing assets, templates, WooCommerce products, order files, and printing options.

Use it to:

  • Let customers design personalized products online.
  • Sell custom printed products through WooCommerce.
  • Create product templates for faster customer design.
  • Manage artwork, fonts, shapes, text presets, and image assets.
  • Set up product design areas, product colors, masks, layers, and views.
  • Configure printing types, quantity discounts, and dynamic pricing rules.
  • Save customer design data to cart and order details.
  • Download print-ready files for production.
  • Build a professional web-to-print or print-on-demand website without custom coding.

Main Features

  • Online product designer for WooCommerce products.
  • Responsive design studio for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Customer text editing with fonts, colors, spacing, outlines, opacity, and styles.
  • Artwork support for SVG, PNG, and JPG files.
  • Customer photo upload with crop, shape, filter, resize, rotate, and flip options.
  • Ready-made design templates for faster personalization.
  • Product base management for apparel, print products, merchandise, and custom items.
  • Multiple design areas for front, back, sleeves, labels, panels, or custom print zones.
  • Product color options using predefined colors or a color picker.
  • Dynamic pricing for printing types, sizes, colors, views, and quantities.
  • WooCommerce cart and checkout integration.
  • Design thumbnails in cart, checkout, order details, and emails.
  • Print file download for SVG, PNG, and PDF output, depending on configuration and plan.
  • Admin dashboard for resources, orders, and system requirements.
  • Addon and theme management for extending the design studio.
  • Multi-language support and built-in language editor.
  • Shortcode support for adding the design studio to pages.

Admin Management

Product Designer App includes a dedicated admin workspace so store owners can manage the full product personalization process.

  • Dashboard with resource totals, order statistics, and system status.
  • Order management with customer details, design thumbnails, notes, and print file access.
  • Quote management in the Premium version.
  • Product base creation, editing, importing, exporting, duplication, and searching.
  • Multiple product layers for realistic product previews.
  • Design area configuration for one or many printable areas.
  • Mask layers for advanced mockups and print boundaries.
  • Product color, quantity discount, layout, artwork, and template settings.
  • Artwork bulk upload, bulk edit, folder organization, search, and multi-language data.
  • Template creation using the same design tools available to customers.
  • Import and export tools for backup, migration, or fast setup.
  • Printing type setup with fixed price, price by color, price by size, price by area, and quantity rules.
  • Addon install, activation, deactivation, upgrade, and per-product configuration.
  • Theme install, activation, CSS editing, and one-click upgrades.
  • Global settings for uploads, download formats, text, tools, fonts, shapes, filters, languages, cache, and updates.

Customer Design Tools

Customers get an intuitive online design experience that helps them personalize products quickly.

  • Add, edit, move, resize, rotate, copy, lock, flip, and delete design elements.
  • Add text from presets or create custom text.
  • Customize fonts, colors, spacing, outlines, opacity, and text style.
  • Add artwork from the store library.
  • Upload photos in supported image formats.
  • Recolor supported SVG artwork and template elements.
  • Apply crop, shape, and filter options for photos and artwork.
  • Use undo, redo, reset, preview, zoom, fullscreen, rulers, and view switching tools.
  • Group and ungroup selected elements.
  • Reorder layers from the layer panel.
  • Add multiple variations of the same design to cart.
  • Save design notes with the order.
  • Use QR code, barcode, team name and number, save/load, quote, and hotkey features in the Premium version.

WooCommerce Integration

Product Designer App works with WooCommerce to connect product customization with the shopping workflow.

  • Link product bases to WooCommerce products.
  • Assign design templates to specific WooCommerce products.
  • Display a Customize button on product pages.
  • Save design data to cart and checkout.
  • Generate thumbnails for cart and order previews.
  • Update product design prices dynamically.
  • Support classic and block-based WooCommerce cart and checkout.
  • Save design information in WooCommerce orders.
  • Show design thumbnails in order details and customer emails.
  • Allow customers to reorder previous customized products in supported versions.

Shortcode

Use this shortcode to display the Product Designer App studio page:

[pdapp-studio-page id="1"]

Premium Version

Product Designer App Pro unlocks advanced features for professional print shops and high-volume personalization stores.

Premium features include, depending on version and addon configuration:

  • One-click import of product bases, templates, artwork, fonts, themes, and other resources.
  • Advanced product attributes and variant management.
  • Quote request workflow.
  • Save and load customer designs.
  • Cart design editing for classic WooCommerce cart.
  • High-quality PNG, PDF output.
  • Artwork and template pricing.
  • Team name and number tools.
  • QR code and barcode tools.
  • Photo library.
  • Watermark settings.
  • Hotkeys.
  • Product duplication.
  • Share design features.
  • Additional addons, themes, updates, and support.

Learn more about Product Designer App Pro: https://productdesignerapp.com/shop/woocommerce

Free vs Pro Comparison

Product Designer App is available as a free plugin and paid premium licenses for stores that need more production features, resource imports, support, and unlimited order file downloads.

  • Free – Best for testing the basic WooCommerce product designer workflow. Includes limited features, 1-domain usage, no included technical support, no resource import, SVG print file export, and limited order file downloads for up to 10 orders.
  • Basic – Best for small stores that need essential premium benefits. Includes core features unlocked, latest versions, lifetime updates, 1-domain license, 3 months of technical support, free resource imports, unlimited order file downloads, and SVG/PNG print file export.
  • Professional – Best for serious print shops and personalization businesses. Includes the complete feature package, all features fully unlocked, latest versions, lifetime updates, 1-domain license, 6 months of technical support, free resource imports, unlimited order file downloads, and SVG/PNG/PDF print file export.

Key premium advantages include:

  • Access to the latest premium version and lifetime updates.
  • Free resource imports for product bases, artworks, fonts, templates, themes, and addons.
  • Unlimited order file downloads.
  • Advanced print file export options.
  • Custom product views, design templates, layer manager, undo/redo, save design, customer design downloads, and edit design in cart.
  • Premium tools such as photo library, team members, QR code generator, barcode generator, watermark preview, hotkeys, request a quote, product variants, duplicate product design, quick color selection, related products, and addon system.

See the full license comparison: https://productdesignerapp.com/shop/woocommerce

Important Notes

  • WooCommerce product variants are not fully supported in every workflow. For best results, set up a single WooCommerce product and manage design options inside Product Designer App.
  • Starting from version 1.0.9, the free plugin focuses on WordPress and WooCommerce compatibility updates. Product Designer App Pro continues to receive full bug fixes, feature updates, and support.
  • Always back up your website and design data before upgrading.

External Services

Product Designer App connects to ProductDesignerApp.com APIs for update notifications and, for Premium users, resource imports such as product bases, artworks, templates, fonts, themes, and addons.

Premium users may need to provide a purchase code for verification. Product Designer App may store the personal information you provide for account and purchase verification, such as your email address and PayPal transaction ID. The plugin does not store passwords or other login credentials. Access is handled by a secure login code sent to your email.

Terms of Use: https://productdesignerapp.com/term-condition

Privacy Policy: https://productdesignerapp.com/privacy-policy

Dependency Libraries

The plugin uses third-party JavaScript libraries. These dependencies are licensed under the MIT license, and uncompressed source code is available for development review.

  • Barcode: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
  • Chart.js: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
  • CircleType: https://github.com/peterhry/CircleType
  • ColorThief: https://github.com/lokesh/color-thief
  • Hotkeys: https://jaywcjlove.github.io/hotkeys-js
  • jsPDF: https://github.com/MrRio/jsPDF
  • Moveable: https://github.com/daybrush/moveable
  • Selecto: https://github.com/daybrush/selecto
  • QRCode SVG: https://github.com/papnkukn/qrcode-svg
  • Spectrum Colorpicker: https://github.com/bgrins/spectrum
  • SVG Colors: https://github.com/snorpey/get-svg-colors-browser
  • Vue.js: https://github.com/vuejs/vue
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher.
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher.
  • PHP 7.0 or higher.
  • MySQL 5.0 or higher.

Recommended Requirements

  • PHP 8.1 or higher.
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher.
  • WordPress memory limit of 1024 MB or higher. 2048 MB or more is recommended for large stores.

Installation from WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Product Designer App.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate.
  5. Open Pages > Add New and click the PDA button to access the Product Designer App admin panel.
  6. Configure product bases, design areas, templates, artwork, printing types, and WooCommerce product links.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Product Designer App plugin zip file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Go to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins.
  4. Activate Product Designer App.
  5. Complete the plugin setup from the Product Designer App admin panel.

After Installation

  1. Create or import a product base.
  2. Add design areas, colors, layers, and product preview images.
  3. Upload artwork or import resources.
  4. Create design templates.
  5. Configure printing types and pricing rules.
  6. Link the design product to a WooCommerce product.
  7. Test the customer design workflow from product page to checkout.

For step-by-step help, read the installation guide at https://docs.productdesignerapp.com/docs/installation and the product setup examples at https://docs.productdesignerapp.com/docs/product-setup-examples.
sections.faq:
What is Product Designer App?

Product Designer App is a WooCommerce product designer plugin that lets customers personalize products online and helps store owners manage design assets, templates, print options, orders, and print-ready files.

Who should use this plugin?

Product Designer App is ideal for print shops, print-on-demand businesses, apparel stores, gift stores, stationery shops, sign makers, promotional product companies, and WooCommerce stores that sell customizable products.

Does Product Designer App work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Product Designer App integrates with WooCommerce products, cart, checkout, orders, order emails, and product pricing.

Can customers upload their own images?

Yes. Customers can upload supported image files and use photo editing tools such as crop, resize, rotate, shapes, filters, opacity, flip, and positioning options.

Can I create ready-made templates?

Yes. You can create reusable design templates so customers can start from professional layouts and customize text, images, colors, and other design elements.

Can I download print-ready files?

Yes. Store owners can download production files from orders. Output formats include SVG, PNG, and PDF, depending on plugin configuration and plan.

Does the plugin support dynamic pricing?

Yes. You can configure printing types and pricing rules based on fixed price, color count, size, design area, quantity, views, and other print settings.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The design studio is responsive and works on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Does Product Designer App work with all WordPress themes?

Product Designer App is designed to work with themes that follow WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards. For best performance, use a lightweight, well-maintained theme.

Do I need coding skills?

No. You can create products, templates, design areas, artwork libraries, and pricing rules from the admin panel without writing code.

What is the difference between the free version and Product Designer App Pro?

The free version includes the core product designer workflow. Product Designer App Pro adds advanced production features, resource imports, quote tools, save/load designs, premium addons, advanced pricing options, additional output controls, and full support.

Where can I get help?

Use the documentation, help center, feedback page, or social channels:

  • Documentation: https://docs.productdesignerapp.com
  • Help center: https://help.productdesignerapp.com
  • Bug reports and feedback: https://productdesignerapp.com/feedback
  • Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/productdesignerapps
  • X: https://x.com/pdesignerapp
  • YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@productdesignerapp

  • Access to the latest premium version and lifetime updates.
  • Free resource imports for product bases, artworks, fonts, templates, themes, and addons.
  • Unlimited order file downloads.
  • Advanced print file export options.
  • Custom product views, design templates, layer manager, undo/redo, save design, customer design downloads, and edit design in cart.

See the full license comparison: https://productdesignerapp.com/shop/woocommerce

Important Notes

  • WooCommerce product variants are not fully supported in every workflow. For best results, set up a single WooCommerce product and manage design options inside Product Designer App.
  • Starting from version 1.0.9, the free plugin focuses on WordPress and WooCommerce compatibility updates. Product Designer App Pro continues to receive full bug fixes, feature updates, and support.
  • Always back up your website and design data before upgrading.

External Services

Product Designer App connects to ProductDesignerApp.com APIs for update notifications and, for Premium users, resource imports such as product bases, artworks, templates, fonts, themes, and addons.

Premium users may need to provide a purchase code for verification. Product Designer App may store the personal information you provide for account and purchase verification, such as your email address and PayPal transaction ID. The plugin does not store passwords or other login credentials. Access is handled by a secure login code sent to your email.
